desc: For today's hunter who likes a campfire showpiece that still delivers in the woods, we offer two classic calibers in highly polished hardened brass frames- the .30-30 and the .45-70. The H009BWL carries five of the time-proven mid-bore .30-30 rounds under its 20 octagon barrel, while big-bore hunters tracking bigger game can step up to four of the hard-hitting .45-70 bulldozers in the H010BWL's 22 octagon barrel.
